none: PAS SF-D8FC51: Early Medieval sindle whorl
contea di ritrovamento: Bradford (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead spindle whorl of Walton Rogers form A1, probably dating from the Early Medieval period, about AD 500 - 850. The whorl is circular and has one flat face and one convex face, a shape which is classified as form A1, thought to be in use in AD 500 - 1000. It has a circular central aperture of 8mm diameter.
